lines.en: -Hey, Marie. -Hey!
Did Rachel find you?
No, why?
Oh, she was looking for you.
Oh, well, I guess I'll catch up with you later.
Well, she really wanted to talk to you now.
Yeah, it, uh, seemed pretty important, but...
Oh, no.
What?
I think I might know what this is about.
Really?
Yeah, uh, uh, we promised we weren't gonna tell anybody this,
but, uh, about a month ago,
uh, Rachel and I slept together.
And?
Well, I thought you'd be a little more shocked, uh...
Oh, I'm sorry.
And?
Well, we, we said we'd just do it that one time.
But, but now, I, I think she may wanna start things up again.
Yeah, I don't think that's what it is.
